arms.B5_STRONGEST_FAITHFUL_PARENT_FEDERATION: ceiling control (ME-X1 strongest faithful federation via mex1_arms.ArmRunner; cost recorded, not capped)
arms.CBR_KG_RETRIEVAL: oracle-independent comparator: 2-hop KG retrieval, (module,status) defeater signature, Jaccard-nearest of the 14 public known-answer fixtures, action reused, reopened set adapted from the neighbourhood
arms.KSO_M2_SOLVE: reserved; joined from lane-ocm-3's receipt with --kso-column; rows may carry navigation_outcome, attribution, translator_invariant
arms.KSO_NAVIGATION_ONLY: derived from the KSO receipt: navigation_only_answer (what EXTRACT returned without a store read); the mechanic's honest number; paired against RWR and CBR
arms.RWR_PPR_SPREADING_ACTIVATION: oracle-independent comparator: undirected warrant-gated RWR/PPR (alpha 1/3, exact fixed point), highest-activated reachable defeater decides (registered action / DEFER if censored / UPDATE if none); PROPAGATE_DEFEAT reopens accepted claims whose support carries a reachable INVALID atom

budget.overrun: CANNOT_CHECK for that arm-instance, never scored; run exit 2
budget.wall_proxy: ops = steps + edge_visits (wall_ns recorded, not capped)

commitment.random_control_seed: mex1 ArmRunner(spec, inst.seed) with the instance's registered seed; null band re-seeds (inst.seed ^ 0x4E55) + 7919*(k+1), k < 200

exit_codes.2: could not check (overrun, modules unimportable, unreadable KSO column)

gates.K1: random control inside the 200-sim null band; oracle-peeking plant outside
gates.K2: positive control exactly 1.0; one perturbed answer breaks it
gates.K3: no CANNOT_CHECK under the matched caps; --cap-scale 0 plants an overrun -> exit 2
gates.K4: paired red on 12 planted flips (p<0.001), quiet on a copy (p=1)
gates.K5: one graph digest / seed set / status map per instance

graph.digest: shared with kso_m2_solve_v1.graph_sha256: sorted 'A|id|type' lines then sorted 'E|edge_id|tails|heads|relation_type' lines (comma-joined tails/heads), newline-joined, no trailing newline
graph.request_level_atoms: kso_m2_solve_v1.add_request_atoms(pop, w1, inst) when present beside the module (lane-ocm-3; sha bound in the receipt); otherwise M1_ONLY and the receipt says so
graph.seed_set: S = {req:<instance_id>, claim:<target_claim_id>} ∪ {res:<result_id> if populated}, uniform over |S|, warrant-gated, no renormalisation

information_matching: every arm: the ME-X1 ArmView; graph arms: one populated graph, one seed set, one typed-module status map (mex1_arms._status_for, all modules typed) per instance; CBR additionally reads the 14 public fixtures; no arm imports mex1_oracle
no_post_outcome_edits: the receipt binds this file's sha256 and the module's; a later edit to either re-freezes as V2 with a supersession note
purpose: comparator arms + budget-matching harness for the KSO M2 solve loop (#284 build contract M2, gap row A14); expected honest terminal PARENT_SUFFICIENT; NO NOVELTY OR BREAKTHROUGH CLAIM

scoring.exact: answer.action == Expected.action AND set(answer.reopened) == set(Expected.reopened); OBSTRUCTION/CANNOT_CHECK are not exact and never dropped
scoring.paired: mex1_run.paired_summary semantics (exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs); red iff p < 0.01
scoring.terminal: PARENT_SUFFICIENT iff KSO exact count <= B5 exact count once the KSO column is joined; EXPECTED_WHEN_KSO_COLUMN_MERGED until then

store_read_permissions.rule: label-gated FIRING over graph structure (a dead request atom read through a compose hyperedge's tail gate, KS-T04b) is a mechanic available to every arm that sees the graph; reading a LIVE atom that neither the walk nor firing reached is what store_read flags. Arms that may: B5 (parent modules read the whole world), KSO_M2_SOLVE (COMPOSE; flagged per row). Arms that may not: KSO_NAVIGATION_ONLY, RWR_PPR_SPREADING_ACTIVATION, CBR_KG_RETRIEVAL.

supersession.reason: pre-outcome, before any receipt was scored: (1) graph_sha256 aligned to the shared definition pinned by kso_m2_solve_v1 (newline-joined, no trailing newline) so the two receipts join on one digest; (2) the --kso-column join now refuses rows scored on a different graph (CannotCheck). Arms, caps, seeds, gates and instance set unchanged. (3) K6 byte-reproducibility and body_sha256 are asserted with wall_ns zeroed (a clock is not a result); design provenance reads the commitment block. Still pre-outcome: the first scored receipt is the one committed after this freeze. (4) Coordinator matching correction before gating: a KSO_NAVIGATION_ONLY column (navigation_only_answer from lane-ocm-3's receipt @ 066aaf9; null => OBSTRUCTION; field absent => CANNOT_CHECK, exit 2) is the column paired against RWR/CBR; the full KSO_M2_SOLVE column (COMPOSE may read a live atom the walk did not surface; store_read per row) stays paired against B5 for PARENT_SUFFICIENT; joined exact flags are recomputed (K7); store-read permissions per arm are declared. The first scored receipt on this design is the one committed after this freeze; the receipt scored at 3abbb22 is superseded.
